= \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} 1 & 1 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & \binom {1} {1} & \dots & 0 & 0 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 1 & \binom {n - 3} {1} & \dots & \binom {n - 3} {n - 3} & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & \binom {n - 2} {1} & \dots & \binom {n - 2} {n - 3} & \binom {n - 2} {n - 2} \\ 0 & 1 & \binom {n - 1} {1} & \dots & \binom {n - 1} {n - 3} & \binom {n - 1} {n - 2} \end{array} \right| = D (n - 1, 0) = 1.
\]
所以通过数学归纳法即得.
